Global.Title: Critical Splash Screens: Global Settings
Global.MenuHint: Screen scale, default crit and fumble images, and death, crit, and fumble sound folders.
Global.Intro: Screen scale, default images, and sound folders.
Global.ScaleHint: Fraction of the screen the image fills, for example 0.3 is 30%.
Global.DefaultHint: Used when a character is not set up.
Global.DeathFolderHint: A random file plays when a token gets the "dead" status.
Global.CritFolderHint: Backup: a random file plays when a character has no custom crit sound.
Global.FumbleFolderHint: Backup: a random file plays when a character has no custom fumble sound.
Global.Saved: Critical Splash Screens: global settings saved.

Character.Title: Critical Splash Screens: Per-Character Setup
Character.MenuHint: Add characters (paste an Actor UUID or drag one in) and set their crit and fumble images, sounds, and crit threshold.
Character.Intro: Drag an actor onto a row or paste an Actor UUID. Leave "Crit on" blank for a normal natural 20, or the character's own critical threshold (for example Improved Critical) if lower. Sounds play even when no image is set for that character.
Character.ActorPlaceholder: Drag actor here or paste UUID/id
Character.CritOnTitle: Crit on this value or higher
Character.DropFailed: Critical Splash Screens: couldn't resolve that dropped actor.
Character.Saved: Critical Splash Screens: character setup saved.
